name: Tim Walz

lean.basis: Democratic–Farmer–Labor congressman (2007–2019) and governor of Minnesota since 2019; Kamala Harris's 2024 running mate.

photo.credit: Office of Governor Tim Walz & Lt. Governor Peggy Flanagan

current_role: Governor of Minnesota (since 2019; did not seek a third term; leaves office January 2027)
summary: Tim Walz, a former teacher and Army National Guard veteran, served six terms in the U.S. House before becoming governor of Minnesota in 2019, and was Kamala Harris's running mate in 2024. He dropped his bid for a third term on January 5, 2026 as a welfare-fraud scandal in state-funded social services, seized on by President Trump, intensified; Amy Klobuchar won the race to succeed him.

connections.name: Kamala Harris
connections.description: Harris named Walz her running mate on August 6, 2024; they lost to Trump and Vance.

connections.name: JD Vance
connections.description: Opposing vice-presidential nominees in 2024, including the October 1, 2024 debate; Walz popularized calling Trump and Vance "weird," and Vance questioned the timing of Walz's military retirement.

connections.name: Donald Trump
connections.description: Trump called Walz "grossly incompetent" and "corrupt" over Minnesota's social-services fraud scandal; Walz said Trump and his allies "want to make our state a colder, meaner place" when he dropped his reelection bid in January 2026.

connections.name: Amy Klobuchar
connections.description: Walz endorsed Klobuchar's 2020 presidential bid in February 2019; she ran to succeed him after he withdrew in 2026 and won.

connections.name: Donald Trump Jr.
connections.description: During the 2024 campaign Trump Jr. was among the Republicans who attacked the timing of Walz's retirement from the National Guard.

connections.name: Ken Martin
connections.description: Martin chaired the Minnesota DFL through Walz's House races and his 2018 and 2022 governor wins; based on overlapping roles.
